verdict.rationale: AMD documents ROCm as a primarily open-source stack with Linux support and lists RX 9000-series compatibility, and Linux x86 64-bit OS support is confirmed, but there is no explicit vendor documentation of open-source kernel driver components (e.g., amdgpu upstream kernel module) specific to RX 9070 XT or a clear statement of which parts of the stack are closed-source firmware/blobs. missing for 10: explicit vendor confirmation of upstream open-source kernel module support for this specific GPU, independent/hands-on corroboration of open driver functioning on mainline Linux kernels.
